plan.title: Direct eRFX RFQ Award to PO

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the project title required by the case.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Verify the RFQ stage has a template applied.
Add the requested CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB line item with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet for the line item.
Set the specified delivery location on the first line item.
Verify the delivery location was retained.
Invite two QA vendors so both can submit quotes.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Submit the first vendor's quote at 100.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's quote at 90.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Close the event so awarding is available.
Open the comparison grid containing both submitted bids.
Verify the lowest bid is ranked best before awarding.
Award the complete event to the lowest vendor.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award as the pending buyer approver.
Complete PO creation from the approved award.
Verify one PO contains the awarded line item with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the final event state.
Open the History tab after completion.
Verify this plan's event appears in History.
Verify the historical event shows a completed status.
Reopen the plan's completed event for post-award menu verification.
Verify Recreate Order remains available for the direct event.
